topics.title: Photographer Requests Article After Five Hours
topics.summary: A subject requests Rolling Stone writer to produce an article after spending five hours photographing them, expressing frustration with extended sessions and desiring a piece without photographic content within one-to-two hours.

topics.title: Scheduling Photo Session Negotiation
topics.summary: A subject proposes a two-hour photo session with a photographer, expressing the need for an early start due to prior commitments. The photographer then suggests beginning at noon, leading to further discussion about timing and duration.

topics.title: Stern Discusses Photography Session Concerns
topics.summary: Howard Stern and an unidentified man discuss a photography session, with the photographer expressing concern about image quality. The conversation then shifts to reporting on WYSK's winter 1990 Arbitron ratings.

topics.title: Wysp Offers Travel Mugs, Cash Incentive
topics.summary: Wysp is providing free commemorative travel mugs to the first thousand listeners who send a letter stating they listen to Howard Stern on 94.5 WYSK and offers $100 cash for new Toyota or Chrysler purchases from Conicelli dealerships.

topics.title: Conicelli Toyota Career Fair Event
topics.summary: A car salesman promotes a $100 discount on new Toyotas and Chryslers while simultaneously hosting a career fair. Attendees can interview with firms including Federal Express, AT&T, General Electric Aerospace, and Conrail across multiple locations during April 23rd-25th.

topics.title: Dunkin Donuts Bagel Promotion Details
topics.summary: Dunkin' Donuts is promoting an oven-fresh bagel with cream cheese, butter or jelly and coffee at $0.99 until April 30th. The offer includes plain, onion, and cinnamon raisin bagels.
